changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Paraphrase Generation' as the paper focuses on query reformulation for conversational search, not general paraphrase generation. Removed 'GPT' as it's not actually used in the paper (only mentioned in passing in latency comparison). Added 'Query Reformulation' as the main NLG task.
Removed all metrics as they are retrieval evaluation metrics (nDCG, recall, F1) used to evaluate retrieval effectiveness, not NLG quality metrics for evaluating generated text outputs.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on conversational query reformulation for information retrieval. While it involves generating reformulated queries (an NLG task), the evaluation is primarily on retrieval effectiveness using standard IR metrics rather than NLG-specific metrics. The main contribution is the CQE model for end-to-end conversational search.
